# General Guidelines

These are the always-on core rules.

## Core

- Apply only relevant rules for the current task.
- Keep scope strict; avoid unrelated refactors.
- Follow propose -> approve -> implement -> review -> summary.
- Keep responses concise unless the user requests depth.

## Domain Instructions

Load and apply relevant files under `.github/instructions/`:

- `compliance.instructions.md`
- `engineering.instructions.md`
- `workflow.instructions.md`
- `database.instructions.md`
- `security.instructions.md`
- `reliability.instructions.md`
- `testing.instructions.md`
- `documentation.instructions.md`
- `delivery.instructions.md`
- `quality-ui.instructions.md`

When the user asks to align with established rules, run a domain sweep and explicitly state non-applicable domains.
